releaseNotes: Business upgrades now explain the exact reason whenever an upgrade is unavailable.
Added exact-dollar Owner Investment controls similar to bank deposits, plus Invest All.
Reworked upgrade pricing and Current → After effects by capability, with recurring costs shown explicitly.
Capital purchases are tracked separately from ordinary monthly operating expenses.
Physical business assets can be purchased directly with company cash and installed immediately.
Career offers now use a direct acceptance path and show an exact blocker if they cannot be accepted.
Existing saves migrate to Save Version 12.
